comment: Manual annotations for control flow the tracer can't infer.
comment_entries: VBlank handlers installed at runtime into the RAM trampoline $FF1C72 (jmp abs.l)
comment_patches: Widescreen: g_ws_ext = extra pixels drawn each side (multiple of 8, max 56). Each patch reduces to the original instruction when g_ws_ext == 0, so lockstep is unaffected.

00C74C.why: strafe (A held) speed in the flight model at $00C626 (the one in use when $FF1088 >= 2): sideways velocity = strafe state x 0x80 on the Genesis, against 0x160 for forward flight; the Strafe Speed setting can raise it

00CA4E.why: strafe (A held) sideways thrust, one way: 0xC00 on the Genesis (top strafe speed about a fifth of full flight); the host's Strafe Speed setting can raise it

00CA66.why: strafe sideways thrust, the other way (-0xC00 on the Genesis)

00B3F4.why: free-scroll range: max camera x = window + 512 - (320 + ext)

00B3FA.why: free-scroll range: min camera x = window + ext

00BA54.why: re-window when scrolling left: window starts ext px left of the view

00BA6C.why: re-window when scrolling right: window ends 8 px past view + ext

00BB38.why: camera clamp: max x = map width - (320 + ext)

00BB2C.why: camera clamp: min x = map left + ext

00BCBC.why: marks frames where the scrolling map is shown (renderer widens only these)

00764E.why: per-frame camera update (runs even when the camera is still): playfield marker

002EC2.why: new game starts at campaign g_start_campaign (0 = original)

0088FC.note: sound effect request (d0 = 0..63): the host can play a replacement and skip the Genesis effect

00A6F6.note: damage: d0 = the damage about to come off the target's armour ($32(a1)) at $00A70C, a4 = the weapon entry; the host scales it for the difficulty (flags from the btst are untouched)

00D678.note: weapon fire with no sound (fire sound -1: the AA guns and tanks, weapon entries 3-7): tells the host (id 1100), which can play the Amiga's sound for it; the Genesis stays silent

005BA4.post: { static unsigned spin_; if (!CC_EQ) spin_ = 0; else if (++spin_ > 120000u) goto L_005BA4; }
005BA4.note: scene text loop's vblank wait: the game branches back to the bclr at $005B9C, so a vblank landing just before the bclr is erased; on hardware the phase drifts, but here it can lock every frame and the screen hangs (seen on the mission-failed "You destroyed too many Scud Commanders" screen). The original also misses a few vblanks here in normal play (up to ~20000 spins in the tests), so only after 120000 spins (about a second), keep polling the btst instead (normal waits are untouched, so lockstep still matches)

00890E.post: if (g_music_hook) { int r_ = g_music_hook((int)R.d[0]); g_music_ctx = 0; if (r_ == 1) goto L_0089A4; if (r_ == 2) R.d[0] = 0; }
00890E.note: music / digital sample request (after ext.l d0): 0 stop, 1-99 song, 100+ Z80 sample. Hook result 1: skip it (the host plays a replacement); 2: stop the Genesis music instead

0059C8.note: a cutscene / briefing screen starts ($005994, a1 = its scene record: +$12 picture, +$16 second picture, +$A song): the host can show the Amiga version of the picture

005E36.note: campaign briefing music (table $95C by campaign) is about to be requested: tells the music hook where it comes from
